decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission dated 15 March 2016

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan Received: 15 December 2017. A040716/WD01 Rev G and AO4O716/WD14 Rev A Received: 5 February 2018. AO40716/WD02 Rev D, AO40716/WD07 Rev C and AO40716/WD08 Rev C Received: 05 April 2018. SO-598-01, SO-598-02, SO-598-03, Design and Access Statement and Daylight and Sunlight Study All received: 12 January 2016. SO-598-06 Rev C, SO-598-07 Rev C and SO-598-08 Rev C  All received: 29 February 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted development shall be as shown on the approved plans under this application and as set out within the letter from Richard Keys dated 9th June 2017 received on 14 June 2017 in association with application 01054/72-74/P9(3).

Condition : 4 - The additional commercial floor space within the ground floor rear extension hereby approved shall be used only as offices or storage ancillary to the main use of the premises as A1 retail and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be occupied nor shall any approved use commence until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no occupier of the development shall obtain a parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Condition : 6 - The waste and recycling for the residential and commercial uses and service yard shall be laid out in accordance with approved plan AO40716/WD01 Rev G prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and shall be maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 7 - The cycle parking for the residential flats shall be laid out in accordance with approved plan AO40716/WD01 Rev G prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and shall be maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 8 - The windows formed in the side elevation facing onto 70A Staines Road shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to change an elevation and condition 3 (materials) to change windows from timber to white PVC following approval 01054H/72-74/P9 dated 15/03/2016 for Erection of side and rear extensions at ground, first and second floor levels and rear roof extensions with roof windows to front elevation to form five one bedroom flats, two studio flats with provision of cycle parking and refuse/cycle storage.
